name: Anhui Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Anhui Construction Engineering Group Co., Ltd. engages in the construction works in China. It operates through Investment and Engineering Construction; Intelligent Manufacturing; Sales of Commercial Housing and Social Services; Building Materials and Trade Logistics; Design, Testing, And Consulting; and Emerging Industries segments. The company provides integrated engineering services; prefabricated steel structure buildings, bridge steel structures, shipbuilding, traffic safety facilities, and PC structures; procurement and supply platform for main building materials; Design, testing, and consulting services.
